title: Slice 641293: [Expense Agent] Expense Locations and Per-diem rules in configuration - added check for existing country
summary: Expense Agent setup codeunits now check for existing country and currency codes before creating configuration records, preventing errors when demo data is incomplete.
key_points: Added validation to skip expense location setup for non-existing country codes
Added validation to skip expense rule condition setup for missing data
Added validation to skip expense rule header setup for missing data
Prevents creation failures in customer databases with less data than demo data
quote: Skip creation for setup for non-existing country- and currency codes
